interpretation.representation_floor: two_word_state_residual_floor is the FP64 reference root rounded into high/low float words and reevaluated. It is not a measured production noise floor. interpretation.why_local_pass_is_not_reference_pass: The local projection norm is computed from compiled residual roots after component row-scaling (cardboard_paper_projection_scaling.hpp); the tolerance remains an absolute 2e-8*(1+stateNorm). The independent residual is evaluated on the FP64 source equations at the Metal replay candidate. Left row scaling preserves the mathematical zero set, but does not make finite-precision absolute stopping tests equivalent.
